completionAuthority: TOP manifest.json with state completed; comparator/manifest.json alone is incomplete for this mode

viewKeyKinds.source_actor: referenceUuid nonnull; anchor and fieldSha256 null
viewKeyKinds.source_selector: referenceUuid null; exact anchor and original fieldSha256 nonnull

sourceAssertion: nullable original role-free actor alias assertion, including exact roster/byline context; mutually exclusive with recording-credit facts, never a recording role or canonical identity
historicalViewProfile: people-view-baseline-v1 with people-independent-source-views-v1 retains exactly key, selectorIndexes, projection and facts; trainer reads both exact version pairs

coverage.complete: every selector has one eligible view; same scoped reference deduplicated only within this endpoint
coverage.partial: some eligible views and missing/incomplete selectors
coverage.ambiguous: at least one selector has multiple source actor hypotheses
coverage.unattributed: an unowned selector remains unresolved, even with one nearby actor
coverage.unsupported: no eligible views and no more specific coverage status

matchRecordsAgree: null for no views; otherwise structural equality of all entire PersonMatchRecord values, never an identity assertion
eligibleViews: per selector, one independently attributed actor with complete query projection, or one exact actor_name name-only fallback; ambiguous/unowned alternatives remain only in variants
edgeId: JSON-encoded string array [taskId,candidateEndpointId]; decode as JSON rather than splitting text
completeBag: both endpoint coverage values complete and at least one view each; no implication that different view records agree
leafMeaning: actual ComparePeople for each eligible left/right combination, including leaves from partial bags; no per-leaf target inherited
countMeaning: partialBags: not complete but at least one leaf; unsupportedBags: zero leaves
trainingBoundary: separate trainer authenticates complete bags and all original tasks/bridges before target join; final full-pair-overlap unit total weight 1, only complete identical-five-vector bags initially eligible
